_comment: Demo project seeded into the guest account by `manage.py reset_demo`. Dates are relative: due_in_days is added to today, so the board never looks stale. Tasks reference contacts by their key.
project: CityBike – bike rental app, MVP release

contacts._role: Project lead – this is the logged-in guest user

tasks.title: Show available bikes on a map
tasks.description: As a rider, I want to see all available bikes near me on a map so that I can pick the closest one.

tasks.title: Set up payment provider sandbox
tasks.description: Create a sandbox account with the payment provider, store the keys in the environment and verify a test charge end to end.

tasks.title: End a rental with one tap
tasks.description: As a rider, I want to end my rental with a single tap so that I am not charged for time I do not use.

tasks.title: Write API documentation for the rentals endpoint
tasks.description: Document request and response formats, error codes and the authentication flow so the mobile team can integrate without asking.

tasks.title: Implement refresh tokens
tasks.description: Access tokens currently never expire. Introduce short-lived access tokens with a refresh endpoint and rotate refresh tokens on use.

tasks.title: Sign up with email address
tasks.description: As a new rider, I want to create an account with my email address so that I can rent a bike within a minute.

tasks.title: Design system: buttons and form components
tasks.description: Define the primary, secondary and destructive button styles as well as input, select and checkbox components in the design library.

tasks.title: Admin dashboard with daily rentals
tasks.description: As an operations manager, I want a dashboard showing rentals per day and per station so that I can plan bike redistribution.

tasks.title: Accessibility audit of the checkout flow
tasks.description: Check the checkout flow against WCAG 2.1 AA: keyboard navigation, focus order, contrast and screen reader labels.

tasks.title: Set up CI pipeline with automated tests
tasks.description: Every push runs linting, unit tests and the API test suite. Failing builds block the merge.

tasks.title: Show my rental history
tasks.description: As a rider, I want to see my past rentals with duration and price so that I can keep track of my spending.

tasks.title: Project kickoff and backlog grooming
tasks.description: Align on MVP scope, define the definition of done and prioritise the first two sprints.
